question: Can you provide the total number of sessions for each traffic channel in December 2020, using the information from the 'event_params'
sql:
WITH session_source AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'source') AS source,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'medium') AS medium,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'campaign') AS campaign
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_202012*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '01' AND '31'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'source')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'medium')
),
session_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN campaign IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(campaign) LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
           AND LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'retargeting', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           AND LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp')
           AND LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'retargeting', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           AND LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'retargeting', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
           OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS traffic_channel
  FROM session_source
)
SELECT traffic_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS total_sessions
FROM session_classified
GROUP BY traffic_channel
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC
